primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: 6MWT was performed by standardized procedures for all participants. Participants were asked to walk a set course of 25 meters for 6 minutes (timed), and the distance walked (in meters) was recorded. Change from baseline in 6MWT distance at Week 96 was reported.

groups.description: Participants with genotypically confirmed Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD) with genetic deletions amenable to treatment by exon 51 skipping received Eteplirsen as an Intravenous (IV) infusion, at a dose of 30 milligram per kilogram (mg/kg) once weekly for 96 weeks.
groups.title: Eteplirsen 30 mg/kg

groups.description: DMD participants with mutations amenable to skipping of any exon(s) except exon 51 did not receive any treatment, but completed study assessments up to 96 weeks.
groups.title: Untreated Control Group (Non-exon 51 Amenable Participants)

primaryOutcomeMeasures.populationDescription: Primary efficacy set: all participants in the efficacy set (all participants in eteplirsen-treated and untreated control groups who had at least 1 post-baseline functional assessment) who had a Baseline 6MWT distance of 300 to 450 meters, inclusive. Here, "Overall Number of Participants Analyzed"=participants evaluable for this outcome measure.
primaryOutcomeMeasures.title: Change From Baseline in the 6 Minute Walk Test (6MWT) Distance at Week 96
